candidates.name: Evercraft Clip Social Video Production
candidates.problem: An authorized user needs a source video turned into a small set of social-ready vertical clips with bounded rendering, transparent limits and governed downstream distribution.
candidates.pricing: Canonical customer price is $4.99 one-time (499 cents USD). An authenticated Clip checkout control plane and provider-verification path are deployed, but the live checkout gateway currently reports payment authority unconfigured, so this must not be represented as sell-now yet.
candidates.confirmation: Public discovery and planning create no payment obligation. Customer checkout requires an authenticated human and explicit $4.99 confirmation; rendering remains locked until Stripe reports paid + complete and exact amount, currency, and order metadata all verify.
candidates.invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
candidates.authority: Machine-commerce contract only. The offer state below is authoritative for public routing and must not be upgraded by inference.

candidates.name: Evercraft Clip
candidates.confirmation: Preserve the product-specific human confirmation boundary before any checkout, payment obligation, external handoff, or consequential action.
candidates.invocation_status: Route through the universal Evercraft discovery surface unless a bounded specialist interface is later verified.
candidates.authority: public read-only capability discovery and non-executing job planning; media submission, paid processing, and publishing remain authenticated and human-authorized
boundaries: public agent tools do not upload private media
public agent tools do not create orders, checkout, payment, or publication
current customer server renderer is bounded to 35 MiB sources, up to 3 clips, and 8-45 seconds per clip
Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram publishing code paths exist, but queue existence is not provider publication proof
TikTok publishing is not currently verified and must not be represented as live
ForensiScope is the recommended upstream overflow and understanding layer for long or complex media; automatic media transfer is not yet claimed
